title: adas1236/KaltonPeckPalomar
abstract:
We prove the following mod-2 identity for real symplectic Banach spaces:
  If $(X, \omega)$ is a real symplectic Banach space, and $T \in L(X)$ satisfies:
    (1) $I + T^+T$ is Fredholm
    (2) $I + T^2$ has finite rank
  Then
    $\rank(T^2 + I) \equiv \dim \ker (I + T^+T) \pmod 2$.
In the above, $T^+$ represents the symplectic adjoint. See our paper for more depth in definitions. This identity is applied to show that no hyperplane of the real Kalton-Peck space has a complex structure. We note that in our notation, a symplectic Banach space always assumes that the symplectic form \omega is a strong symplectic form. See our paper for more detail on the definitions.
We formalize:
 (1) The mod-2 identity for arbitrary real symplectic Banach spaces
 (2) An application of the identity to show that if $T \in L(Z_2)$ and $T^2 + I$ has finite rank, then $T^2 + I$ has even rank.
     Here, Z_2 is the real Kalton-Peck space.
 (3) The corollary that no hyperplane of the real Kalton-Peck space has a complex structure.
